claims.harm: Circular dependency between libbitcoin_crypto and libbitcoin_util via memory_cleanse symbol.
claims.quote: There still exist a circle dependency between libbitcoin_crypto and libbitcoin_util. In particular, the former depends on the memory_cleanse symbol.

claims.harm: Layering violation where a util header depends on a common header.
claims.quote: It seems like a bug to have a util header depending on a common header.
claims.settled_by_quote: Code review ACK 34970bde23dd87fc0fea5a1970880761f7184774. Main change since last review is no longer moving the spanparsing.h file here, to avoid making util depend on common.

claims.harm: Unnecessary linking of bitcoin_kernel into bitcoin-cli.
claims.quote: I would be surprised if bitcoin-cli needed to be linked with the kernel. It appears to build without this.
claims.settled_by_quote: Addressed @achow101's comments 1, and 2, dropped left over kernel library links where they are no longer needed.

claims.harm: Unnecessary linking of bitcoin_kernel into bitcoin-wallet.

claims.settled_by_quote: Addressed @achow101's comments 1, and 2, dropped left over kernel library links where they are no longer needed.

claims.harm: Adds library complexity, backwards dependency edges from common/wallet to kernel, and fails to update design doc and check-deps.sh.
claims.quote: Should be updating the design doc, and it would be nicer if this was reducing the complexity of all our libraries rather than adding another one to menagerie.
claims.settled_by_quote: Addressed @ajtowns' comment, adding some more edges that were documented by check-deps, and a new libbitcoinkernel node to the mermaid diagram.

claims.harm: CMake configuration failure during cross compilation due to missing Boost::headers target.
claims.quote: CMake Error at src/CMakeLists.txt:127 (target_link_libraries): Target "bitcoin_kernel" links to: Boost::headers but the target was not found.

claims.harm: Breaks build when Bitcoin Core is consumed as a CMake subproject due to CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR pointing to the parent project directory.
claims.quote: Would PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR be more appropriate here? When Bitcoin Core is used as a subproject, CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR points to the parent project’s source directory.
